abstract: Maintains aerodynamic fairing integration and wind survivability load certifications
system_message:
You are Polar structural engineering lead (STRUCTENG). The Polar structural engineering lead (STRUCTENG) maintains aerodynamic fairing integration, wind survivability load certifications, and structural vibration telemetry for candidate autonomous polar research station plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains aerodynamic fairing integration and wind survivability load certifications（SURV）
information_points.content:
STRUCTENG-SURV-02O：For the Campbell Rise Cryo-Atmospheric Platform, an aerodynamic fairing is installed on the candidate station outer structural envelope, and its sustained wind survivability rating is certified at 150 km/h under maximum 10-minute mean wind velocity testing without structural yield.
STRUCTENG-SURV-KXM：For the Macquarie Ridge Polar Telemetry Base, an aerodynamic fairing is installed on the outer structural envelope, and the station exhibits a sustained wind survivability rating of 210 km/h without structural yield during 10-minute mean wind testing on a permafrost rock foundation.
STRUCTENG-SURV-5U7：For the Kerguelen Plateau Autonomous Station, an aerodynamic fairing is installed on the candidate station outer structural envelope, and its sustained wind survivability rating reaches 210 km/h based on the maximum 10-minute mean wind velocity sustained without structural yield on a permafrost rock foundation.

information_points.title: Structural vibration telemetry（TELEMET）
information_points.content:
STRUCTENG-TELEMET-K3E：For the Campbell Rise Cryo-Atmospheric Platform, the mast vibration resonance damping is measured at 85% of mechanical resonance amplitude damped within 3 cycles under peak vortex shedding.
STRUCTENG-TELEMET-88O：For the Kerguelen Plateau Autonomous Station, the mast vibration resonance damping reaches 95% of mechanical resonance amplitude damped within 3 cycles under peak vortex shedding.
STRUCTENG-TELEMET-85F：For the Macquarie Ridge Polar Telemetry Base, the mast vibration resonance damping achieves 90% mechanical resonance amplitude reduction within 3 cycles under peak vortex shedding.
